This does not establish translation meaning or unit equivalence.",
    "PASS — display helper implementation: src/features/healthclues/wellness-plan.ts selects bilingual snapshot copy for AI-generated goals. Historical rows without snapshots retain stored text; user-authored text remains unchanged. Persistence and UI wiring are not independently established by this helper.",

Imported parser, proof and UI implementations were not supplied.",
    "PASS — limited guest regression coverage present: scripts/test-healthclues-localization.mjs checks translation-key coverage, guest preference, legacy C01/C02 canonical answers and position across locale navigation/reload, and viewport overflow. It does not authenticate or complete the approved current player journey.",
    "PASS — reported scoped acceptance: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md records bilingual persisted-display fixture success and sampled authenticated legacy World/Plan continuity at build 3319, followed by localized recommendation-fixture and presentation acceptance at build 3322. These are report claims, not independently reproduced or visually inspected in this audit.",
    "REWORK — untranslated component copy: src/features/healthclues/PersonalizedSuggestions.tsx contains hard-coded English headings, preference choices, actions, empty states and errors without locale selection. Its reachability in current approved flows is unknown.",
    "UNVERIFIED — broader coverage: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_LOCALIZATION_ACCEPTANCE.md identifies incomplete station/catalog, knowledge, game, error and dynamic-content localization. Later scoped successes in App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md do not establish complete coverage of these surfaces.",
    "UNVERIFIED — current regression scope: scripts/test-healthclues-localization.mjs expects the concern-first discovery prompt after Start Journey and does not assert the latest approved world-first, two-screen discovery, factor preservation, activation or immediate My Journey selection persistence.",
    "UNVERIFIED — live integration: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md records a genuine provider/application HTTP 200 with four bilingual goals after earlier billing/schema failures. It records no Plan save for that response; later persistence evidence uses intercepted synthetic recommendations. Current live bilingual quality and end-to-end persistence remain unaccepted.",
    "REWORK — documentation reconciliation: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_16_ACCEPTANCE.md describes source-registry and blanket numeric restrictions superseded by the simplified contract and later owner clarification in App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md. The localization report's earlier account/browser omissions are partially superseded by later scoped evidence.",
    "UNVERIFIED — safety regression breadth: scripts/test-healthclues-wellness-plan.mjs provides deterministic synthetic safety and topic-isolation assertions, predominantly in English; it does not establish equivalent EN/VI safety-message or semantic coverage."
  ],
  "knownLimitations": [
    "Only supplied excerpts and source/report blocks were reviewed. Repository status, current runtime, hashes and unsupplied implementation wiring were not independently inspected.",
    "No screenshot pixels or execution artifacts were supplied for direct inspection; no visual PASS is assigned.",
    "Translation-key presence and matching digit sequences do not prove linguistic accuracy, equivalent units or clinically reviewed Vietnamese content.",
    "Historical AI records without bilingual snapshots retain their original language. Persisted original 96-question answers remain unverifiable because the reported sampled profiles lack them.",
    "The latest supplied MP20 state reports focused fixture UI success, but authenticated activation and immediate Plan persistence remain unverified."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Full acceptance lacks current-flow authenticated EN/VI desktop/mobile evidence across discovery, activation, World, Pet, My Journey, NPC and remaining accessible game surfaces.",
    "Reviewed bilingual content and a persisted authenticated legacy-answer fixture are not established by the supplied evidence."
  ],
  "nextSuggestedSteps": [
    "Reconcile historical acceptance statements with later scoped results, retaining explicit fixture, live-provider and visual-verification boundaries.",
    "Trace PersonalizedSuggestions usage; localize its reachable player-facing strings and add focused EN/VI coverage without changing canonical values.",
    "Update the localization regression for world-first two-screen discovery and run two synthetic local accounts through activation, locale persistence/isolation, World/Pet/NPC, immediate A/B/Custom selection, uncheck, zero goals and reload on desktop/mobile; inspect the resulting screenshots.",
    "Keep historical translation and original legacy-answer preservation explicitly unverified until valid source translations or a persisted answer fixture are available. Record live-provider persistence separately from fixture acceptance."
  ]
